items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: John, myself, uh, uh, uh, Chuck Beatty, we were impression we were gonna be two weeks and come back... Harold and Melvin and Tammy and, uh, John Boudreaux stayed out.

ctx.x: Now, we were supposed to go out there for two weeks and come back to New Orleans. Right. Unbeknownst to most of us, other than Harold and Melvin, that they figured that's where we should be. Yeah. Now, I didn't know, we didn't know how, uh, John, myself, uh, uh, uh, Chuck Beatty, we were impression we were gonna be two weeks and come back.
What, what they were thinking was, stay, get out there. Stay, set up the business out there. Yeah.
